Hunt down the Mythic Skippy Alternator and Iconic Legend skins, and earn Eddies throughout the event to spend in the Reward Shop.

The third film in the universe, "War" was released in 2019 and starred Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff in pivotal roles. "Pathaan" was the fourth instalment in the Spy Universe franchise which was released in 2023 starring Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone and John Abraham. "Tiger 3", the fifth instalment in the YRF Spy Universe and the third film in the Tiger series, starring Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif and Emraan Hashmi, released in 2023. "War 2", the sixth film in the YRF Spy Universe, starring Hrithik Roshan, NTR and Kiara Advani, directed by Ayan Mukerji, released on 14 August 2025. "Alpha", the seventh film in the franchise and Hindi cinema’s first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, released on 3 July 2026.

snippet.title: Official West End Trailer | Jesus Christ Superstar
snippet.description:
The London Palladium - Summer 2026 
Theatre Royal Drury Lane - Autumn 2026 
UK Tour - 2027

Book Now ⬇️
http://www.jesuschristsuperstar.com/

A global phenomenon that has wowed audiences for over 40 years, Jesus Christ Superstar is a timeless work set against the backdrop of an extraordinary and universally-known series of events but seen, unusually, through the eyes of Judas Iscariot.

It was the first musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice to be produced for the professional stage and first came to major theatres when it debuted on Broadway in October 1971 at the Mark Hellinger Theatre in New York.

Less than 12 months after the Broadway show opened, the rock spectacle went to London, exploding onto the West End at the Palace Theatre in August 1972 in a hugely successful production. By 1980, after 3,358 performances, Jesus Christ Superstar had become the longest running musical in West End history at the time and grossed $12.3 million.

In all, Jesus Christ Superstar has grossed over $205 million and has been professionally produced in 42 countries around the world!

snippet.title: Age of Umbra: Sallowlands | Official Trailer | A Daggerheart Miniseries
snippet.description:
The Sallowlands beckon—immerse yourself into the world and characters of this new Daggerheart mini-series premiering July 9th! Rumors swirl of a gargantuan metropolis appearing suddenly, deep in the cracked ancient lakebed of the Sallowlands. Five survivors hope that finding it will give them what they each desperately need.

AGE OF UMBRA: SALLOWLANDS
A group of outcasts and survivors brave blasted lands in search of answers in Age of Umbra: Sallowlands. This 6-part Daggerheart mini-series features Game Master Matthew Mercer and players Laura Bailey, Jennifer English, Abubakar Salim, Vico Ortiz, and Zachery Renauldo. They’ll form an unlikely band of companions, who venture off the beaten path in search of answers in the Sallowlands, a new region of the Halcyon Domain filled with cracked badlands, dangers, and awe-inspiring secrets. What fragile hopes dare they cling to in this story of desperation and survival? Learn more at https://critrole.com/umbra

snippet.title: Dinosaurs of the Wild West | Official Kickstarter Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
Worldwide Pre-Order on Kickstarter Now: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sparkefilms/dinosaurs-of-the-wild-west-series

From the creative team behind the 2025 cult-dinosaur feature PRIMITIVE WAR comes an ambitious new original cinematic universe: DINOSAURS OF THE WILD WEST.

In an alternate frontier, humanity navigates a dangerous land where every journey, every town, and every war depends on the giant creatures that shaped civilization itself. Dinosaurs of the Wild West is an epic adventure series that reimagines the American frontier through a world millions of years in the making.

Massive Brontosaurs haul entire towns across the frontier.
Raptors are ridden into battle.
Pterosaurs rule the skies.

For generations, humans and dinosaurs shaped the world together.
Now something is coming that threatens to change that forever.

Narrated by actor Jesse Kove. Inspired by the illustrated world of creator Shaun Keenan. 

Alongside the full trailer, DINOSAURS OF THE WILD WEST Kickstarter campaign unveils  a mix of EARLY BIRD and LIMITED EDITION rewards that include:
 VIP ON SET EXPERIENCES
 FIRST EDITION TRADING CARD SET
 BEHIND THE SCENES ACCESS
 ASSOCIATE PRODUCER CREDITS
 And the opportunity to CREATE A DINOSAUR for the series.

Stretch goals for the campaign include expanded creature sequences, additional cinematic set pieces, major guest appearances, and the unlocking of future episodes. 

Currently the ONLY way to watch is to pre order the series through kickstarter. 

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Dinosaurs of the Wild West is an original cinematic universe created by filmmaker Luke Sparke and developed alongside a team of artists and visual effects talent behind Primitive War and multiple internationally released feature films. It’s produced by Carmel Imrie, Carly Sparke and Luke Sparke with Executive Producers Geoff Imrie, Eric Weick, Colin Hurdle, Kelly Clifford, Luke Sparke

The two promos were completed in house by Luke Sparke, Sparke Films, Let It Be Entertainment and Sparke Effects including VFX artists Vivian David, Jared Johnson, Mark Griffiths, Julien Romeo, Felipe Gonzalez, Evan Robinson, Alejandro Agudelo and in conjunction with Kubo vfx studio. VFX Supervison by Luke Sparke, Post Produced by Carly Sparke, Executive Creative Brooke Marsden and original score by Frederik Wiedmann.

Instagram:  @dinosaursofthewildwesttv & @primitivewarmovieofficial  
TikTok: @primitivewarmovie
Facebook:  @primitivewarmovie
Official Site: DOTWW.com

When Tommy receives a phone call inviting his band to open for Green Day on New Years Eve, he doesn’t realize it’s an elaborate prank by his older brother, Wayne. What follows is a rowdy and uproarious road trip across America, inspired by Green Day’s early days of touring in a van, years before the release of their breakout record Dookie.

snippet.description:
One boxer's fight for revenge turns out to be the biggest battle of his life. Watch the official trailer for #Fightland, from Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson. Step into the ring July 31 only on STARZ. 

#STARZ #Fightland 

Subscribe to the STARZ YouTube Channel: http://bit.ly/1kalhP0

Facebook: http://starz.tv/STARZFacebookYT
Instagram: http://starz.tv/STARZInstagramYT
YouTube: https://starz.tv/STARZYouTube
TikTok: https://starz.tv/STARZTikTokYT

When newly crowned British-born heavyweight boxing champion Duke Kilroy sees his brother
die in a frenzied assault, Duke snaps. After spending eight years in a U.S. prison, he returns
home to London seeking vengeance against the man he believes set him up – criminal kingpin,
and his former promoter, Kingsley Marshall. But Kingsley has disappeared, leaving his children
and his wife, Joy (the love of Duke’s life), to pick up the pieces. Working with a cartel desperate
to control London’s drug market, Duke begins a high-risk game to infiltrate Kingsley’s empire
and destroy it from within. And when Kingsley returns, Duke will take his revenge.

On 29th June 1996 Simply Red performed at Old Trafford Stadium in Manchester to 60,000 fans as part of the ‘Euro '96 Extravaganza’, to celebrate the final match of the UEFA Euro ’96 Championship. 

'Holding Back the Years: 40 Years of Simply Red, Live in Santiago' is out now: https://simplyred.lnk.to/LiveInSantiagoYT

Simply Red are thrilled to announce 'Recollections', their brand-new album celebrating 40 incredible years! Featuring 40 newly recorded versions of their most loved songs, the album is available digitally, on 4LP vinyl, as a 3CD set, and as a 2LP highlights edition, out now: https://SimplyRed.lnk.to/RecollectionsYT

Subscribe to Simply Red - https://www.youtube.com/@simplyred/featured?sub_confirmation=1

Follow Simply Red:
https://www.facebook.com/simplyred/
https://twitter.com/SimplyRedHQ
https://instagram.com/simplyredofficial
https://www.tiktok.com/@simplyredofficial
https://www.threads.net/@simplyredofficial

Simply Red have over a billion hits on YouTube, have sold over 60 million albums worldwide, 5 going to number one in the UK. Their 1991 classic Stars was the best-selling album for two years running in Britain and Europe. They have had two US Billboard chart toppers with classic singles Holding Back The Years and If You Don’t Know Me By Now. Every Simply Red studio album has been a UK top ten (with previous release Big Love reaching number 4 in 2015). Hucknall has been the songwriter and bandleader since the beginning in 1985.

Lyrics
Holding back the years
Thinking of the fear I've had so long
When somebody hears
Listen to the fear that's gone
Strangled by the wishes of pater
Hoping for the arms of mater
Get to me the sooner or later

I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on

Holding back the years
Chance for me to escape from all I've known
Holding back the tears
Cause nothing here has grown
I've wasted all my tears
Wasted all those years
And nothing had the chance to be good
Nothing ever could yeah, oh

I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
So tight

I've wasted all my tears
Wasted all of those years
And nothing had the chance to be good
Cause nothing ever could, oh, yeah
Oh...

I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
Holding, holding, holding

That's all I have today
It's all I have to say

#SimplyRed #OldTrafford #HoldingBackTheYears
tags: if you don't know me by now
you make me feel brand new

snippet.title: Popcaan x Shenseea – Love Done Dead | RiddimBars | Emotional Dancehall Breakup Song 2026
snippet.description:
Popcaan x Shenseea – Love Done Dead | RiddimBars | Emotional Dancehall Breakup Song 2026




A heartfelt dancehall breakup anthem about two lovers watching a once beautiful relationship fall apart. Love Done Dead blends modern dancehall, reggae fusion, and soulful Caribbean melodies into an emotional story filled with regret, memories, and feelings that never truly disappear.




Popcaan and Shenseea deliver emotional performances as two hearts struggle to let go after love fades. With honest storytelling, relatable lyrics, and a memorable singalong chorus, Love Done Dead captures the pain of missing someone who was once your everything.




Perfect for late night listening, heartbreak playlists, emotional moments, and lovers of smooth Caribbean music.




Expect:

• Emotional breakup storytelling

• Catchy singalong chorus

• Smooth dancehall and reggae fusion vibes

• Powerful male and female chemistry

• Honest relationship emotions

snippet.description:
This is Minecraft But we're Upgrading VERITY Into a GOD In Minecraft! When Steve's body gets transformed into VERITY like the Mecha Verity, Snake Verity, Cosmic Verity, and more, he needs to UPGRADE himself by entering the mysterious portals! Steve needs to learn how to evolve himself to absurd levels so he can use the VERITY overpowered upgrade abilities! Can Steve learn all the secrets and abilities of the evolution upgrades, get all the VERITY upgrades, and upgrade into the ultimate VERITY? What's gonna be VERITY's TRUE FORM? This is Upgrading VERITY into a GOD in Minecraft
__

👋🏼 Checkpoint Website: https://checkpointmultiverse.com/
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/checkpoint.yt
❤️ Connect With Us: https://direct.me/checkpointmultiverse
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Join the Community on Discord: https://discord.gg/jkfV7mSxB6

🎵 Additional Music provided by Epidemic Sound: https://www.epidemicsound.com/

MORE CHECKPOINT ADVENTURES:

‣ MINECRAFT DIMENSION: https://bit.ly/3mKfUOL

Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

I played in a Minecraft SMP, or survival multiplayer server similar to SMP Earth, Dream SMP, or Lifesteal SMP (lifesteal smp season 2). Like ParrotX2 and his School's Minecraft Server / School SMP Series where he Started a War or Ended a War. Not Technoblade / TommyInnit / or any other Dream SMP member. This is a new and original Minecraft idea like HermitCraft or LastLife with Grian and MumboJumbo. Survival is harder than Hardcore Minecraft because PVP is on. 

In this minecraft video, I became IMMORTAL on this LIFESTEAL SMP. I did this on a copy of the Lifesteal SMP, also known as the deadliest minecraft server to exist, and it was super intense. The Lifesteal SMP features creators such as ClownPierce, PrinceZam, Leowook, Parrot, Spoke, roshambo, and more. snippet.title: Mourning's End Part II Unguided
snippet.description:
I wasn't lying when I said I've sunk hours into this idle game, (it's genuinely great) - let me know if you also enjoy it too! Download it here: https://idleobeliskminer.com/alienfood #ad

Welcome to Unguided, where I'm trying to complete every quest in old school runescape without using a guide, wiki or plugins. I'll only be using my limited knowledge and in-game learnings. Full rules below.

Watch the full Unguided series here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZ1r83HxniSXUcxA2uRNHNWqyMDDRtUtZ&si=nNge3LpA1fqhdubt

RULES
- No use of OSRS wiki (or any equivalent) for anything - this includes looking up item spawns, quest guides, boss guides, anything
- No use of any other quest helper sites
- No use of quest helper plugin 
- Essentially no use of any outside-game assistance

CAVEATS
- I love OSRS YouTube, I might inadvertently learn something I don't know by watching my favourite content creators, but I'm not going to stop watching them so that's just a risk I'm willing to take + it's unlikely going to be relevant for me
- I may use some QoL plugins, but only a few. Loot tracker to prove grinds, ground items so I don't miss drops (and to add cool loot beams lol) and left click to use bones. Nothing that will give me info I didn't previously have
- I'm going to try and avoid any spoiler comments. If you can, please try not to help me if there's an episode where I'm stuck on something. I appreciate the sentiment but telling me an item spawn or quest step could spoil the fun :)

Music:
OSRS OST

#runescape #oldschoolrunescape #osrs #ironman #series
